Futur I with Werden: German B1 Exercises

Build Futur I with werden and a final infinitive. Practise predictions and plans while distinguishing future forms from passive voice.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the rule

Futur I combines a present-tense form of werden with a bare infinitive at the end: Die Lieferung wird morgen ankommen. The auxiliary agrees with the subject. German also uses the present for many future plans; Futur I is one option, not a requirement whenever tomorrow appears.

Common mistake to avoid

Werden + infinitive forms Futur I; werden + past participle can form a passive. Do not replace ankommen with angekommen in this future pattern.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice the form that changes and the role it plays in each sentence.

Worked example 1Die Lieferung wird morgen ankommen.The delivery will arrive tomorrow.
Worked example 2Wir werden den Vertrag nächste Woche prüfen.We will check the contract next week.
Worked example 3Du wirst die Adresse bald finden.You will find the address soon.
Worked example 4Ihr werdet den Unterschied merken.You all will notice the difference.

Practice: fill in the gaps

Use the present-tense form of werden to complete Futur I. Keep the final infinitive. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Ich ___ dich am Sonntag besuchen. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: werde

Ich takes werde; besuchen stays at the end.

Question 2. Der Laden ___ bald schließen. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: wird

A singular subject takes wird.

Question 3. Ihr ___ die Ergebnisse später bekommen. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: werdet

The ihr form is werdet.

Question 4. Wir ___ im Juni umziehen. (werden)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: werden

Wir takes werden in the present-tense auxiliary slot.

Use it in your own sentence

Make a prediction that your friend will arrive late.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Sie wird heute wahrscheinlich später ankommen.

Check your wording: Wird is the finite auxiliary; ankommen stays infinitive at the end.

What to practise next

Change the subject or noun in one model sentence. Check the verb form, case and word order before comparing it with the rule.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
